name: agent-trace
description: Browser DevTools for AI agents — record, replay, and fork agent runs
author: Victor

scripts.pack:check: pnpm prepare:publish && bash -lc 'cd packages/core && npm pack --pack-destination /tmp && cd ../cli && npm pack --pack-destination /tmp'
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm prepare:publish && pnpm --filter @evolving2code/agent-trace-core publish --access public && pnpm --filter @evolving2code/agent-trace publish --access public
